model: Lowara hydrovar X HVX+ Smart Controller (BACnet MS/TP)
equipment_type: Multi-pump controller for pump frequency drives
applies_to: Xylem Lowara HVX+ Smart Controller, the multi-pump control unit for hydrovar X frequency converters.
summary: The HVX+ Smart Controller runs a multi-pump set of hydrovar X drives and has its own BACnet MS/TP interface. Analog Inputs give the ten-entry error log with logged values, error and alarm bitfields, actual pressure, flow, temperature and level, required values, pump status, speed, I/O values and firmware versions; Analog Values hold on/off, error reset and the controller parameters (control mode, setpoints, ramps, thresholds, sensor scaling, multipump settings, communication).
notes: The tables have no read/write column; Analog Values are taken as writable and Analog Inputs as read-only.
Object names are full parameter names (different from the short tags of the HVX drive list), so this is a separate list.
AV 0 On/Off Set uses 0 = on, 1 = off.
Units follow unit-selection parameters (P04.0.11-P04.0.16) where the description names one.
Names kept as printed, including "Error n - End Time 1", "Senorless or Sensored" and "Temperature - Minimum Thresho".

source.title: HVX+ Smart Controller - Additional Installation, Operation and Programming Instructions, ch. 10.4-10.6

integration.summary: Switch the pump set with AV 0 (0 = on, 1 = off) and reset errors with AV 1. Choose the control mode (AV 3) and setpoints; read pump status (AI 140), actual pressure (AI 134), required value (AI 139), speed (AI 144) and the error and alarm bitfields.
integration.enable: AV 0 On/Off Set switches the system (0 = on, 1 = off), the same as the ON/OFF button.
setup: MS/TP settings are AV 139-145 (MAC, baud, format, device ID, Max Master, info frames, reinit).
gotchas: Bitfield objects must be split into bits; meanings are in the manual.
